description: Fetch full curated UniProtKB entries by accession in one batch of up to 20 distinct accessions; repeats collapse, and any further accessions return in deferredAccessions to pass as accessions on the next call. Each entry carries alternative names, function, EC numbers and catalytic activity, cofactors, active and binding sites with their ligands, subcellular location and membrane topology, disease involvement, PTMs, molecule processing (signal, propeptides, chains), natural variants, isoforms, domains, free-text comments (PTM, pathway, subunit, tissue specificity), GO terms with their evidence, keywords, cross-references, and Ensembl gene IDs; mutagenesis and IntAct interaction partners come back when sections or fields name them. Partial failures do not abort the batch — resolved entries land in succeeded[] and unknown or inactive (merged, demerged, deleted) accessions in failed[], where an inactive accession names its replacement or UniParc ID. Pass fields to trim the upstream projection; a field this tool cannot return (e.g. sequence) is not requested and is listed in ignoredFields with a notice. Each record is measured on its own across both output surfaces: one within 24,000 UTF-8 bytes returns in succeeded[]; a larger one is listed in outlinedEntries with its size instead. Re-call an outlined accession alone, e.g. accessions:["P04637"], for its section outline (kind: "outline", sections with byte sizes), then add sections:["disease","variants"] to select sections. sections takes exactly one accession; trim a batch with fields instead. All returned list items and cross-reference IDs render in full. A large list section pages with section_limit/section_offset on a re-call naming that one section. This tool does not search: accessions come from uniprot_search_proteins.results[].accession or uniprot_map_ids. Strip any isoform suffix (P04637-2 to P04637) before calling.

accessions.description: Accessions to fetch (1–500). Repeats collapse to their first occurrence; the first 20 distinct are fetched and the rest return in deferredAccessions, in order, for the next call. From uniprot_search_proteins or uniprot_map_ids.

items.description: A UniProtKB primary accession, e.g. "P04637". Canonical form only — strip any "-N" isoform suffix.

fields.description: Comma-separated UniProtKB return-field names to fetch in place of the default record, e.g. "accession,cc_function,ft_variant,xref_pdb" — trims a batch. Omit for the default record. The identity fields always come back. Names are case-insensitive; keywordid is sent as keyword and rhea as cc_catalytic_activity. Any xref_ field (e.g. xref_reactome) fills xrefs. A field this tool does not return (e.g. sequence, which uniprot_get_sequence returns, or ft_helix) is not requested from UniProt and comes back in ignoredFields with a notice listing the supported fields. An xref_ database UniProt does not know, or text that is not a field name, fails invalid_fields with UniProt's message.

section_limit.description: Window size for one list section on a sections re-call: return at most this many items of it (at least 1; a value past the remaining items returns them all). Requires sections naming exactly one list section, e.g. ["variants"] (or ptms, domains, goTerms). Omit together with section_offset to return the whole section.

section_offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item in the windowed section. Defaults to 0. Pass the previous response's nextOffset to page forward. Same requirements as section_limit; set without section_limit, returns every item from this index on.

sections.description: Section keys to return for one accession, e.g. ["disease","variants"]: the record is cut to these plus its identity fields. Re-call an accession with it after a kind: "outline" response, or name the on-request sections mutagenesis and interactions, which the default record leaves out — without fields, naming one fetches it; with fields, include ft_mutagen or cc_interaction there. Requires exactly one accession: a batch with sections is rejected, so trim a batch with fields. A requested section the record lacks is named in absentSections, not an error.

items.description: A section key of the entry record, e.g. "disease", "variants", "mutagenesis", "interactions". Case-insensitive.

name: uniprot_get_entry

absentSections.description: Requested section keys this record does not carry — UniProt holds no annotation of that kind for it, or fields excluded it. Not an error: the other requested sections are returned. Present only on a sections re-call that named one.

items.description: A requested section key the record does not carry.

cap.description: The section_limit applied. Present when truncated.

deferredAccessions.description: Distinct accessions past the first 20, in submission order — not fetched. Pass them as accessions on the next call, which fetches their first 20 and defers the rest again. Absent when nothing was deferred.

items.description: A submitted accession this call did not fetch.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `sections_single_accession`: sections was passed with more than one submitted accession (a repeat counts) — rejected before any request. sections re-calls a single outlined record. `unknown_section`: sections named a key this tool never emits — rejected before any request. The message lists every valid key. `invalid_section_window`: section_limit or section_offset was set without sections naming exactly one list section — no sections, several, or a non-list section such as organism or xrefs. Rejected before any request. `all_not_found`: None of the fetched accessions resolved to an active entry — each was unknown to UniProtKB or inactive (merged, demerged, or deleted) — and none was deferred. The message names each inactive accession and its replacement. `invalid_fields`: UniProtKB rejected the fields value — the message relays UniProt naming the rejected field. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: Accessions that did not resolve to an active entry — unknown to UniProtKB, or inactive (merged, demerged, or deleted) — in request order.

accession.description: The requested accession that did not resolve.

error.description: Why it failed and how to recover. For an inactive accession: the merge target to retry with, the demerge products to choose among, or the UniParc ID that keeps a deleted sequence.

ignoredFields.description: Names in fields this tool does not return, in request order — left out of the UniProt request, so the call answered without them. Absent when every name was returned.

items.description: A requested field name, lowercased, that this tool does not return.

kind.description: Result kind. "full": read succeeded[], failed[], and any outlinedEntries and deferredAccessions — every call with more than one distinct accession or any failure. "outline": a lone accession whose record alone exceeded 24,000 UTF-8 bytes; read sections and re-call it with sections:[...].

nextOffset.description: section_offset for the next window (same section_limit). Present while items remain.

notice.description: Re-call guidance. On a single-record outline: re-call that accession with sections:[...] to pull specific sections. When outlinedEntries is present: re-call each listed accession alone. When deferredAccessions is present: pass them as accessions on the next call. On a section window: the section_offset that pages the rest, or why the window came back empty. When ignoredFields is present: the ignored fields, where to get them, and the fields this tool returns.

outlinedEntries.description: Resolved entries whose one-accession result alone exceeds 24,000 UTF-8 bytes, in request order — not inlined. Re-call each alone for its section outline. Absent when every resolved record fits.

items.description: A resolved entry too large to inline, and its size.

accession.description: Accession to re-call alone with accessions:[accession].

bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes of this record returned alone, across both output surfaces — the measure the 24,000-byte budget compares.

sections.description: Section outline for a lone accession whose record alone exceeds the 24,000-byte budget. A batch lists such records in outlinedEntries instead.

items.description: An outlined section with its serialized size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section.

name.description: Section identifier — pass a subset in sections:[...] to retrieve it.

shown.description: Items in the returned window. Present when truncated.

succeeded.description: Entries that resolved and fit the 24,000-byte per-record budget, in request order. Present when kind is "full"; empty when none did.

alternativeNames.description: Alternative full protein names. Absent when none.

catalyticActivity.description: Catalytic-activity reactions (Rhea-cross-referenced). Absent when not an enzyme.

ecNumber.description: Enzyme Commission number. Omitted when none.

rheaId.description: Rhea reaction ID, e.g. "RHEA:10596". Omitted when none.

cofactors.description: Cofactors. Absent when none are annotated.

comments.description: Free-text annotations by type (PTM, PATHWAY, SUBUNIT, TISSUE SPECIFICITY, and the other free-text types), plus any DISEASE note that names no disease. Absent when none.

evidence.description: Source evidence codes. Omitted when none are attached.

molecule.description: The isoform or chain the text is about, e.g. "Isoform 2". Omitted when none.

type.description: UniProt comment type, e.g. "PTM", "PATHWAY", "SUBUNIT", or "DISEASE" for a disease note that names no disease.

disease.description: Disease involvements (DISEASE comments). Absent when none.

diseaseId.description: UniProt disease accession, e.g. "DI-01537". Omitted when none.

note.description: How the gene is involved, e.g. "The disease is caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry". Omitted when none.

domains.description: Domain and region features. Absent when none.

description.description: Free-text description of the feature. Omitted when absent.

featureId.description: Stable feature identifier, e.g. "VAR_066493". Omitted when none.

end.description: End residue position. Omitted when not exact.

start.description: Start residue position. Omitted when not exact.

ecNumbers.description: EC numbers of the recommended name. Absent when none.

ensemblGenes.description: Distinct Ensembl gene IDs behind the transcript IDs in xrefs.Ensembl. Absent when none.

function.description: FUNCTION annotations. Absent on most TrEMBL entries.

items.description: An annotation with its source evidence preserved.

evidence.description: Source evidence codes. Omitted when none are attached.

genes.description: Every name of each gene in UniProt order: gene name, synonyms, ordered-locus names (e.g. "b3296", "JW3258"), and ORF names (e.g. "J0580").

items.description: A gene name, synonym, ordered-locus name, or ORF name.

aspect.description: GO aspect: P (process), F (function), or C (component).

evidenceType.description: GO evidence code and its assigning source, e.g. "IDA:UniProtKB" or "IEA:InterPro". Omitted when none.

interactions.description: Binary interaction partners (IntAct). Absent when none.

chain.description: This entry's chain when the interaction is recorded for one product of a polyprotein, e.g. "PRO_0000037540". Omitted otherwise.

experiments.description: Number of IntAct experiments supporting the interaction.

gene.description: Partner gene name. Omitted when none.

isoform.description: This entry's isoform accession when the interaction is recorded for one, e.g. "P04637-7". Omitted otherwise.

organismDiffer.description: True when the partner comes from another organism. Omitted otherwise.

partner.description: Partner UniProtKB accession — an isoform accession when IntAct names one.

partnerChain.description: The partner chain when IntAct names one product of a polyprotein, e.g. "PRO_0000037536". Omitted otherwise.

isoforms.description: Isoforms (ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS). Absent when only one product.

sequenceStatus.description: Sequence status, e.g. "Displayed" or "Described". Omitted when none.

mutagenesis.description: Site-directed mutagenesis: each residue change with its observed effect as the description. Absent when none.

items.description: A mutagenesis experiment: the residue change and its effect.

featureId.description: Variant identifier, e.g. "VAR_066493". Omitted when none.

end.description: End residue position. Omitted when not exact.

start.description: Start residue position. Omitted when not exact.

original.description: Original residue(s). Omitted when not a substitution.

variation.description: Variant residue(s); several substitutions tested at one position are comma-separated, e.g. "A,P". Omitted when not a substitution.

commonName.description: Organism common name. Omitted when none.

mnemonic.description: Organism mnemonic, e.g. "HUMAN". Omitted when none.

processing.description: Molecule processing: signal peptide, transit peptide, propeptides, chains, peptides, and initiator methionine. Absent when none.

description.description: Free-text description of the feature. Omitted when absent.

featureId.description: Stable feature identifier, e.g. "VAR_066493". Omitted when none.

end.description: End residue position. Omitted when not exact.

start.description: Start residue position. Omitted when not exact.

proteinName.description: Recommended full protein name. Omitted when none.

ptms.description: Post-translational modification features (modified residues, glycosylation, etc.). Absent when none.

description.description: Free-text description of the feature. Omitted when absent.

featureId.description: Stable feature identifier, e.g. "VAR_066493". Omitted when none.

end.description: End residue position. Omitted when not exact.

start.description: Start residue position. Omitted when not exact.

reviewed.description: True for reviewed Swiss-Prot, false for unreviewed TrEMBL.

sites.description: Active sites, binding sites with the ligand they bind, and other functional sites. Absent when none.

items.description: An active site, a binding site with its ligand, or another functional site.

description.description: Free-text description of the feature. Omitted when absent.

featureId.description: Stable feature identifier, e.g. "VAR_066493". Omitted when none.

ligand.description: The ligand a binding site binds. Omitted on active sites and other sites.

chebiId.description: ChEBI identifier, e.g. "CHEBI:29108". Omitted when ChEBI does not cover the ligand.

label.description: Tells apart copies of one ligand bound at different sites, e.g. "1". Omitted when none.

note.description: Curator note on the ligand, e.g. "catalytic". Omitted when none.

ligandPart.description: The part of the ligand the residue binds, e.g. the Fe of heme b. Omitted when none.

chebiId.description: ChEBI identifier of the part. Omitted when none.

name.description: Name of the ligand part, e.g. "Fe".

end.description: End residue position. Omitted when not exact.

start.description: Start residue position. Omitted when not exact.

subcellularLocation.description: Subcellular locations. Absent when none are annotated.

topology.description: Membrane topology. Omitted when not applicable.
Membrane topology: topological domains, transmembrane and intramembrane segments. Absent when none.

description.description: Free-text description of the feature. Omitted when absent.

featureId.description: Stable feature identifier, e.g. "VAR_066493". Omitted when none.

end.description: End residue position. Omitted when not exact.

start.description: Start residue position. Omitted when not exact.

featureId.description: Variant identifier, e.g. "VAR_066493". Omitted when none.

end.description: End residue position. Omitted when not exact.

start.description: Start residue position. Omitted when not exact.

original.description: Original residue(s). Omitted when not a substitution.

variation.description: Variant residue(s); several substitutions tested at one position are comma-separated, e.g. "A,P". Omitted when not a substitution.

items.description: A cross-reference identifier in that database.

xrefs.description: Cross-reference IDs keyed by database name as UniProt spells it. The default record carries PDB, Ensembl, RefSeq, ChEMBL, AlphaFoldDB, InterPro, Pfam, HGNC, MIM, GeneID, and STRING; fields with an xref_ name (e.g. xref_reactome) adds that database. GO terms are in goTerms, never here. Chain a PDB id into protein-mcp-server, a ChEMBL id into chembl. Absent when none.

totalCount.description: Items in the windowed section before section_limit/section_offset applied. Present on every windowed call; 0 when the record lacks the section.

truncated.description: True when items remain past the returned window. Absent on the final window.

window.description: The window applied to succeeded[0]'s one requested section. Present only when section_limit or section_offset was set; totalCount and nextOffset place it in the full section.

offset.description: Index of the first returned item within the full section.
